reviews: I bought these sneakers for my 6 year old for the first day of school. He loved the light-up heels and the velcro is easy for him to do himself. By the third week the sole had peeled away from the toe on both shoes and he was tripping on the flap. For $35 I expected them to last at least until Halloween. Back to the store we go.

I have worn this brand of dress sock since 1978.  They used to last me two or three years.  The last dozen pairs I ordered had holes in the heels within two months and the elastic at the top gave out after a few washings.  I can only assume the manufacturing has been moved somewhere cheaper.  I will not be buying them again.
R.  Thompson.
ok so this hoodie looked sick in the pic but irl the print is all cracked after 1 wash. like i washed it cold and everything. total waste of 30 bucks dont get it

The fabric on this wrap dress is soft and the color is gorgeous, exactly like the picture. Unfortunately the 2X fits like a large. The wrap doesn't cover anything if you have a bust and the tie only reaches halfway around. I really wanted to love it but it went back the same day.

This nursing bra is impossible to unclip with one hand, which is the whole point of a nursing bra.  While I'm fumbling with the clasp the baby is screaming.  The cups also stretched out after a week so now I have no support at all.  Do not recommend.

I ORDERED THESE BOOTS ON NOVEMBER 3RD AND IT IS NOW DECEMBER 20TH.  NO BOOTS.  NO EMAIL.  NO TRACKING NUMBER.  I HAVE CALLED FOUR TIMES AND EVERY TIME THEY SAY IT SHIPPED.  SHIPPED WHERE???  DO NOT ORDER FROM THIS SELLER

The case itself is well made and the leather smells great.  But the cutout for the click wheel is about 3mm off center so you can't press the menu button without pulling the iPod halfway out.  The screen cover also fogs up in cold weather.  Nice idea, poor execution.  I'm back to using it naked.

I am from Philippines and I wait 6 weeks for this item. When arrive the color is not the same of the picture, is more like orange not red. Also the size is very small, I order large but is like small. Very sad because I pay also the tax of customs

I bought this watch for my husband's 40th birthday.  It came in a really nice box and he liked the look of it.  Two weeks later the crown fell off in his hand and the date stopped changing.  Very embarrassing to have your birthday present break that fast.  We are returning it

Bought these for marathon training. By mile 8 of my first long run I had a blister the size of a quarter on each heel. The heel counter is stiff and sits too high. I've run in a lot of shoes and never had this happen. Went back to my old pair.
Great news for anyone who has always wanted to know what it feels like to walk on gravel. These sandals will give you that experience everywhere you go, even on carpet

Pros:
1.  Nice looking leather
2.  Plenty of card slots

Cons:
1.  The bill compartment is 1/4 inch shorter than a dollar bill, so bills stick out
2.  Stitching started fraying in week two
3.  Too thick to fit in a front pocket

Overall I can't recommend it.  Looks good on the shelf, not in use.

I ordered these satin heels to dye for my wedding. The dye took unevenly and the left shoe came out two shades darker than the right. The bridal shop said the satin is not real satin and that's why. Two weeks before the wedding and I'm shoe shopping again. Avoi

I'm a nurse and I'm on my feet 12 hours a shift.  These clogs are comfortable for the first few hours, I'll give them that.  After that the footbed packs down and my arches are killing me by the end of the shift.  They also squeak on the hospital floors so everyone hears me coming.  Not worth the price for professional use.

Sooo cute in the picture and honestly cute in person too. But the zipper on the side is so cheap it split the second time I wore the skirt. Literally at a party. Cute does not matter if it falls off you
Fell apart in a week

These pajamas shrank so much after the first wash that my 4 year old's ankles show. The tag says to wash warm, which I did. Now they fit his little sister. Spend a few more dollars and get a better brand

For thirty years I have bought my khakis from this company.  This order, I am told, is "a new relaxed fit." The pockets are shallower, the fabric thinner, and the price higher.  I have returned them and will look elsewhere for the first time since 1975
the colors on these socks are dope and they're super soft at first, i'll give em that. but they pill like crazy and after like 3 washes they look like they're 5 years old. kinda dissapointed tbh

Another "plus size" swimsuit made by someone who has never seen a plus size woman. The bottom is cut so high in the back that I couldn't walk to the pool in it. The top has no support at all. I'm a 22 and the 22 doesn't fit

The diaper bag is adorable and has lots of pockets. However the changing pad is so thin it's basically a placemat, and the strap clip broke the first time I hung it on the stroller. Everything fell in a puddle. Cute bag, terrible hardware.
WRONG ITEM SENT TWICE!!!  I ORDERED THE BLACK AND GOT BROWN.  SENT IT BACK.  THEY SENT BROWN AGAIN.  NOW THEY WANT ME TO PAY SHIPPING AGAIN TO RETURN THEIR MISTAKE.  RIDICULOU

This FM transmitter picks up more static than music.  I tried every frequency from 88.1 to 107.9 and there was always a hiss.  In the city it's useless because every station bleeds through.  The plug also wiggles in the lighter socket and cuts out when you hit a bump!
The product never arrive to Brazil.  The seller say it was sent but no tracking.  I write email three times and no answer.  I lose my money.  Please be careful with this vendo

Bought this scarf for my mom for Christmas because it said cashmere blend. It feels like a cheap acrylic and it made her neck itch within ten minutes. She was nice about it but I could tell. I was embarrassed

The shorts have a nice liner and a key pocket, which I liked.  But the seam on the inner thigh is in exactly the wrong place and chafed me raw on a 5 mile run.  I tried them twice more with body glide and same result.  Into the donation bin.
If you've been looking for a raincoat that lets the rain in so you can stay in touch with nature, look no further

I measured the wallet when it arrived: 4.75 inches by 3.5 inches. The listing says 4.25 by 3.25. That half inch is the difference between fitting in my pocket and not fitting. Also, it says "genuine leather" but the edges are clearly a vinyl coating that is already peeling. Returned

The dress arrived quickly and the beading is lovely up close.  The problem is the bodice.  It's so stiff and so oddly shaped that it gaps at the top no matter how it's altered.  My seamstress said she couldn't fix it without taking it apart.  I ended up wearing something else to the gala

These work boots are advertised as waterproof.  I walked across a wet lawn on the job site and my socks were soaked by 9am.  The steel toe is fine but the rest of the boot is no better than a sneaker.  Not acceptable for work boots at this price
The color is NOT what is shown. The picture is a pretty dusty rose and what I got is basically salmon. It doesn't go with anything I own. So annoyed
Way too small. Returned

My daughter picked this backpack herself and she was so excited about the unicorn print. The stitching on one shoulder strap came undone in October and the other one followed in November. Second backpack of the school year. The print was cute but I'm done with this brand

I purchased this belt to replace one I had worn for fifteen years.  The new one cracked across the third hole within a month.  The leather is bonded leather, which is ground scraps glued together, though the listing does not say so.  I am disappointed that a once fine company now sells this.
these headphones broke after 2 weeks. the left side just stopped working. i didnt drop them or anything. dont waste ur money!

The material on these jeans is nice and thick, I'll say that.  But the waist is cut for someone with no hips at all.  To get them over my hips I need a size where the waist gaps 4 inches.  Belt doesn't fix it, it just bunches.  I'm tired of brands that don't know how curves work
These baby onesies are listed as 6-12 months. My 5 month old could barely get into them. The snaps at the bottom also pop open every time he kicks. I gave up and went back to the brand I had befor
THE SHOES THEMSELVES ARE FINE BUT THE SELLER IS A NIGHTMARE. I ASKED FOR AN EXCHANGE FOR A HALF SIZE UP AND THEY CHARGED ME A 20% RESTOCKING FEE PLUS SHIPPING BOTH WAYS. NEVER AGAIN

Battery life on this watch is supposed to be 2 years. Mine died in 4 months. The design is nice and it keeps good time when it works, but having to replace the battery three times a year makes it more expensive than a much better watch. Not recommended
I buy this jacket for the winter in Canada.  Is not warm at all, the description say is for very cold but I feel the wind come through.  Maybe good for spring but not for winter.  I am not happy!

Ordered this necklace for my girlfriend for Valentine's Day. It looked beautiful when I opened the box. By the end of dinner the chain had turned her neck green. She laughed about it but I didn't. Fake silver, don't buy!

This hydration pack leaked through the bite valve the whole hike. I came home with a wet back and half the water I started with. I replaced the valve and it still leaks from the seam at the bottom of the bladder. Junk
I've always wanted a winter hat that keeps my head exactly as cold as not wearing one.  Mission accomplished.

I'll be fair: the shirt is well cut and the collar holds its shape. However:
- It is 60% polyester, not "cotton rich" as described
- It wrinkles if you look at it
- The buttons are sewn on with a single loop and two have come off already
I won't be ordering the other colors

I bought these control-top pantyhose for my sister's wedding.  They had a run before the ceremony even started and by the reception the waistband had rolled down under my dress.  Very uncomfortable all night.  Cheap product.

Nice looking dress shoe for the office and they look expensive.  The trouble is the sole is so slick that I nearly fell on the tile floor in our lobby twice in the first week.  I had a cobbler put rubber on them for $25, which should not be necessary on a new pair of shoes

I love the style of this bag, it goes with everything and I got compliments the first day. Then the strap tore away from the bag at the rivet on day 4 and my phone went flying. Cute but obviously not built to actually carry anything
Cheap material, looks nothing like the picture

I ordered the toddler rain boots in size 8 because that's what my son wears. These run at least a full size small and he couldn't get his foot past the ankle. The return shipping was almost what I paid for the boots so I just gave them away. Lesson learned

The previous version of this hat was made in England and lasted me a decade. This one has a tag that says otherwise, and the brim has already lost its shape after one rainy afternoon. I suppose I will be looking for the old ones on auction sites

ngl the shoes look clean and i got a lot of compliments.  BUT they give me blisters every single time i wear them, even with thick socks. been 2 months, they're still not broken in. pain is not worth the drip

This bra is advertised up to a G cup. I'm a 40G and the underwire sits right on my breast tissue instead of under it. The band rides up my back within an hour. I've had better luck with department store brands for half the price

This pump bag has a good insulated section for the milk which I appreciated.  But the zipper on the main compartment is so stiff that I have to use two hands and brace the bag against my leg to open it.  When you're pumping at work in a supply closet that's not okay.  Returning
THIS COMPANY CHARGED MY CARD TWICE AND STILL HASN'T SENT ANYTHING.  I HAVE A SCREENSHOT OF BOTH CHARGES.  CUSTOMER SERVICE HUNG UP ON ME.  I'M FILING A DISPUTE WITH MY BANK

The armband is way too small for the 80GB iPod.  It's listed as compatible but you have to stretch the vinyl so much that it covers the screen edge, and the velcro is so short it barely holds on a medium arm.  Fell off on my first jog

The quality of the shirt is good, the material is nice. But they send me the size XL when I order M. I live in Germany and the return is very expensive so I keep it but is too big for me. I don't buy again from this shop!

I got these slippers for my dad who has bad feet. The sole is so thin he can feel every crack in the tile, and the fleece lining matted down after a week. He's back in his old slippers with the holes in them.

The goggles have a great anti-fog coating and the lenses are clear. Sadly the strap snapped at the buckle on my third swim and I had to finish my laps squinting. For a $25 pair of goggles that's not acceptable
Love how these jeans come pre-distressed.  Mine came pre-ripped at the crotch too, after one wear.  Very authentic

I bought two of these travel cubes. Notes after one trip:
1. The zippers caught on the mesh every single time
2. The "large" fits about one pair of jeans
3. One seam split on the flight home
Not usable for a second trip.

The flower girl dress arrived with a stain on the skirt and loose threads hanging from the hem. I ordered it six weeks early and it took five weeks to arrive, so there was no time to return it. I had to scramble to find a replacement locally. Very upsetting

I wait tables and needed non-slip shoes. These are labeled slip resistant but the tread is so shallow I slid on a wet floor in the kitchen my first night. My manager told me to get a different pair. Back they go

The sunglasses are really stylish and look designer.  Unfortunately the lenses are so dark I can't see when I go inside and so cheap that they distort everything at the edges.  Gave me a headache after twenty minutes.  Pretty, but unwearabl
Arrived broken

The coat is warm, I'll give it that, and my son likes the color. But the zipper broke in the second week and now he can't close it. I took it to a tailor and the repair costs almost what the coat did. It's January, so now I'm buying another coat

I have been a loyal customer of this shirt maker for many years.  The latest shirts I received have collars that curl after the first laundering and sleeves an inch shorter than the stated measurement.  I wrote to the company and received a form letter.  A shame.
the beanie is so thin u can literally see through it. not warm at all. my ears were freezing walking to class. 2/10

I was so happy to find a cute leather jacket in my size, and the leather really is soft.  But the arms are cut for a size 6 even though the body is a 2X.  I can't bend my elbows without the seams pulling.  Why do they do this

This crib sheet is supposed to fit a standard crib mattress.  It's so tight that I had to fight with it for ten minutes, and after the first wash it won't go over the corners at all.  A loose crib sheet is dangerous and a sheet that won't go on is useless
SIZE CHART IS A JOKE!!!!! I MEASURED MYSELF THREE TIMES AND ORDERED BY THE CHART AND THE PANTS WOULD NOT EVEN GO OVER MY KNEES. DON'T TRUST IT.

I like that the case has a built in stand for watching videos, that's a clever touch. But the plastic is so brittle that the stand snapped off after a week and left a sharp edge. The screen protector also has bubbles you can't get out. Look for something sturdier
I order this for my son in Mexico and the shoes arrive with the left foot size 9 and the right foot size 8.  How is this possible?  I try to contact and nobody answer.  Very bad experience

My wife loves this brand so I ordered her the matching robe and slipper set.  The robe is nice and plush but the slippers came in two different sizes and the robe belt was missing.  I had to wrap a robe with no belt for her birthday.  Not happy.

The cycling gloves started coming apart at the fingertips after three rides. The padding has already flattened and gives no cushion on longer rides. I expected more from a brand that is supposed to be for cyclists
Finally, a sweater that fits perfectly until you wash it.  Then it fits my cat perfectl

To be fair, the umbrella opens smoothly and the canopy is big. Unfortunately:
1. Two ribs bent in a light breeze
2. The auto-close button sticks
3. The handle came off after a week
I'd rather pay more for one that lasts a season

These bridesmaid shoes were comfortable enough in the store when I tried on the sample.  The pair that shipped to me had the strap sewn on crooked so it dug into the side of my foot all night.  By the end of the reception I was barefoot.  Inconsistent quality
These scrub pants have the shallowest pockets I've ever seen.  My pen and scissors fall out every time I bend over.  The drawstring also came out in the wash.  I need workwear that actually works.
The "faux fur" trim sheds everywhere.  I wore the coat once and my black car seat was covered in white fuzz.  Not cute at all
Smells terrible.  Sent it back.

We bought these swim trunks for vacation and the drawstring isn't attached to anything, so it pulled right out on the first day.  My son spent the trip holding his shorts up with one hand.  Poor design

The overcoat is well tailored, I will grant that, and the wool is of decent weight.  However the lining tore at the armpit after two wearings and one of the horn buttons cracked.  For the price I expected workmanship to match the cloth.  It is going back
the watch looks way more expensive than it is which is cool. but the band gave me a rash after like 3 days and the "water resistant" thing is a lie, it fogged up when i washed my hands. returning it.

I ordered the tall size because I'm 5'11" and still the pants hit above my ankles.  The rise is also very low so I'm constantly pulling them up.  I wish clothing companies would actually test their extended sizes

I really wanted to like this baby carrier.  The fabric is pretty and soft.  But the shoulder straps have no padding and after twenty minutes my shoulders were burning.  My 3 month old is only 12 pounds.  I can't imagine using it when he's bigger.
NEVER RECEIVED MY ORDER. THEY CLAIM IT WAS DELIVERED BUT THE TRACKING SAYS DELIVERED TO A DIFFERENT CITY. THEY WILL NOT REFUND ME. STAY AWAY FROM THIS SELLER
The car charger stopped charging after a week. The light on it still comes on, but no power goes to the phone. I tested it in two cars and with two phones. It's just dead. Waste of money

The bag is very nice design and the leather looks good. But the shoulder strap is too short for me, I am tall man, and is not adjustable like the photo say. I cannot use it on the shoulder. I am disappointed because I wait long time for it.

Bought this tie for my brother's graduation.  The silk is so thin you can see the lining through it, and the tip was sewn crooked.  He wore it once out of politeness.  I won't buy accessories from here again

The trail runners grip well on dry rock and they're light, which I liked.  Then I hit my first stream crossing and they took on water and never drained.  My feet were sloshing for the next 6 miles.  Not suitable for real trail use
These earrings are perfect if your goal is to find out exactly which metals you're allergic to

Received the duffel today. Observations: the "heavy duty" zipper is a #5 coil, not the #10 shown; the shoulder strap hardware is plastic, not metal; and there is no bottom panel, so it sags when loaded. I would describe this as light duty. Returning.

The veil arrived crushed in a tiny envelope and the tulle had permanent creases in it.  I tried steaming it as the seller suggested and the edging melted.  I had to buy a new one from a bridal shop two days before my weddin

The blazer looks professional and sharp from a distance. Up close the fabric shines like a cheap suit and the shoulder pads shifted after the first dry cleaning. I wore it to one client meeting and felt self-conscious the whole time. Not worth it!

I wanted these boots so badly and they are just as cute as the photos.  But the heel is so wobbly that I rolled my ankle walking out of a restaurant.  The shaft also slouches down even though they're supposed to stand up.  Style over substance, sadly
Not as described.  Do not bu

Nice thick fleece and my twins liked the colors.  But the hood comes off with the snaps and both hoods were lost within the first week at daycare.  The hoods are not sold separately.  Now they're just very expensive vests

My father wore these suspenders and so have I for most of my adult life.  The clips on this new pair do not grip and let go every time I sit down.  I expected the same quality I grew up with.  I did not get it
ordered a medium got an xl. sent it back, got an xl again. like do they even read the order lol. not dealing w this company again.

This top is pretty and it drapes nicely in the front. But it's completely see through in the back, which you can't tell from the photos because the model is wearing a jacket over it. Now I need a camisole under it, which kind of defeats the purpose
These nursing pads are so thin they leaked through within an hour. I went through a whole box in three days and still ended up with wet shirts. Disposable or not, they need to actually absorb
THE JACKET IS NICE BUT IT TOOK FIVE WEEKS TO SHIP AND THEY CHARGED ME FOR EXPRESS SHIPPING. WHEN I COMPLAINED THEY SAID "THE CARRIER IS RESPONSIBLE." YOU CHARGED ME, YOU ARE RESPONSIBLE.

I am from India and I buy two pair of this jeans. One pair have a hole near the pocket when I open. The other pair the color come out in the first wash and make my white clothes blue. Very poor quality.
Bought this for my niece's sweet sixteen.  She opened it, looked at it, and asked if I kept the receipt.  I did.

These compression socks are not compression at all.  I have a pair from a medical supply store and these feel like regular tube socks next to them.  They also slid down into my shoes during my run.  Save your money
The "one size fits all" belt does technically fit all.  All children under ten, that is

Measured after one wash in cold water, tumble dry low as per the label: length went from 29 to 27 inches, chest from 22 to 20.5 inches.  The cotton is soft and the print held up, but a shirt that loses two inches is no longer my size.  Returned

The clutch is beautiful in the photos and honestly it's pretty in person. But the clasp doesn't stay closed. I had it fall open twice during the ceremony and my lipstick rolled under a pew. Lovely to look at, frustrating to use

These are sold as chef pants but the fabric is so thin that hot oil splatter went right through to my leg. They also don't hold up to commercial laundry. Two months in and both pairs are faded and fraying at the cuffs
The rhinestones started falling off the sandals before I even left my apartment.  By the end of the night half of them were gone and there was glue showing everywhere.  So chea
Junk. Broke the first day

I wanted to write a balanced review because the other reviews here are all five stars and I suspect most are from people who just opened the box.

What's good: the watch face is large and easy to read, the lume is bright for about an hour after dark, and the band is comfortable.

What's not: after three weeks it was losing about 40 seconds a day. I set it against the atomic clock on my computer every morning for a week to be sure. The crown also doesn't screw down fully, which explains why it fogged after I wore it in the shower (it's rated to 100m, supposedly). A watch that can't keep time is a bracelet. I've sent it in under warranty and I'm told it will be six to eight weeks. Not impressed

I PAID FOR TWO DAY SHIPPING.  IT CAME IN TWELVE DAYS.  THE BOX WAS CRUSHED AND THE HAT INSIDE WAS FLATTENED.  WHEN I CALLED THEY SAID THEY COULD REFUND THE SHIPPING "AS A COURTESY." IT'S NOT A COURTESY, IT'S WHAT I PAID FOR

Honestly the most gorgeous shade of green I've found in a cardigan. But it's so itchy that I can only wear it over a long sleeve shirt, and even then my wrists itch. Plus it's already pilling under the arms. So sad, I wanted this to be my fall staple
wore these to a concert and by the encore i was carrying them. walked home barefoot. thats all u need to know

I ordered three packs of these little girl tights.  Every single pair had a run within the first two wearings, and my daughter is not hard on her clothes.  The waistband also rolls down so she's constantly pulling at them during church.  I'll pay more for the department store brand next time.

The cufflinks are good looking and the box they come in is very nice, which is why I chose them as a groomsmen gift. Unfortunately on three of the six sets the backing mechanism was too loose to stay closed. One of my groomsmen lost his during the photos. I was too embarrassed to say where I bought them
Runs two sizes small.

This is supposed to be a hard shell case for the PSP. The hinge is cheap plastic that popped out of its socket the third time I opened it, and the foam insert is so thick that the PSP doesn't sit flat, so the lid presses on the analog stick. Doesn't protect anything if it doesn't close!

I bought this sports bra for running. It's labeled high impact. It is not high impact, it's barely low impact. Everything moves, and the straps dug into my shoulders after 2 miles. I'd be embarrassed to call this a sports bra

I will say the leather on these oxfords is supple and the color is a handsome dark brown.  That is where my praise ends.  The welt is glued, not stitched, as the description claims, and after six weeks of wear the sole is separating at the toe.  A cobbler told me it would not be worth resoling.  I have owned this maker's shoes for over twenty years and this is the first pair I would not recommend

I was really excited to find a plus size corset style top. It came with no stretch at all in the fabric and the laces in the back only give you about an inch of adjustment. In my usual size I could not breathe. One size up and it was falling off in the bust. Nothing in between

Hello, I live in Spain and I order this sweater as gift for my husband.  When arrive, it have a stain on the front and also it smell like smoke.  I think it is used item.  I write to seller but they say I must pay the shipping to return.  Is not fair
The dress arrived the day after the wedding.  It is lovely.  I will never have anywhere to wear it

I liked that this swaddle blanket was big and made from muslin, perfect for summer. But after two washes it shrank to about half its size and the edges unraveled. Now it's too small to swaddle my newborn. Not worth it even at this low pric

I'll give this wallet credit: it is extremely slim.  That's because it doesn't actually hold anything.  Three cards and it bulges like a pufferfish, four and the stitching starts making noises.  If you only own one credit card and no cash, this is the wallet for you

I bought these steel toe boots based on the claim that they're "comfortable right out of the box." I'm in my third week and my feet still hurt so much at the end of a shift that I'm taking ibuprofen.  The insoles are basically cardboard.  My last pair from another brand never did this

The snow pants are warm and my son stays dry, so that part is fine. The problem is the elastic straps. They're so short that he can't stand up straight when they're attached, and the clips broke the first week anyway. Now he spends recess pulling them up. I wish I'd bought the bib style

I compared this "silk" pillowcase side by side with a silk one I already own.  The burn test (a single thread, done in the sink) confirms it is polyester satin.  It's also about 2 inches shorter than a standard pillow.  The listing is simply inaccurate on both counts.
the strap on this backpack ripped off the first day of finals week. with my laptop in it. luckily the laptop is fine but i'm not. never buying this brand again
THREE WEEKS FOR A REFUND THAT NEVER CAME. THEY SAY THEY NEVER GOT THE RETURN BUT I HAVE THE TRACKING NUMBER SHOWING IT WAS SIGNED FOR. CROOKS
These earrings are so heavy they stretched my earlobes after a couple of hours.  Plus the gold color is already rubbing off.  I've had cheaper earrings last way longer.
I bought this sweater for my father-in-law because it said 100% merino. The label inside says 30% wool, 70% acrylic. He was nice about it but he knows his wool. Please correct the description

The charging dock looks great on a nightstand and the speaker is clear at low volume. Turn it past halfway and it crackles. The dock connector also doesn't line up with the iPod nano unless you hold it at an angle. I've had it a month and I've gone back to plugging into my computer

I've worn the brand's previous model for five years of hiking. This new version is lighter, which I liked. But they changed the sole and the grip is much worse. I slipped twice on wet granite on my first trip with them and that has never happened in the old ones. I'll be looking for the old model on clearance.
Don't bother

I love the print on this blouse and it's flattering in the shoulders. But the buttons gap across the bust in every size I tried, and I tried three. I ended up safety pinning between the buttons, which isn't something I should have to do with a new top
For forty years I wore this brand of undershirt.  This year they have new tags, a new cut, and a new tendency to develop holes along the neckline.  I prefer the old ones.
The material is good and the color is nice.  But the size chart is wrong, the measures say 42 cm but when I measure is only 38 cm.  Now my son cannot use it.  Please make the chart correct

These shapewear shorts rolled down my thighs and up from my waist at the same time, so by dinner I had a tube around my middle.  I had to excuse myself to take them off in the ladies room.  Do not wear these under a fitted dress
The car seat cover is adorable but it doesn't actually fit on our car seat, which is one of the most popular models. The elastic is too short and it pops off the back. I've given up on it.
Fantastic socks if you enjoy them migrating down into the toe of your shoe every three steps. Great cardio, bending down to fix them all day!

This tie looks fine in the photo and fine when you first put it on. But the lining is so thin that it twists at the knot by lunch, and by the afternoon I look like I slept in it. For a work tie I wear daily, it's just not good enough

We needed dress shoes for a wedding and these looked nice online. My 8 year old wore them for one evening and complained the whole time. When we got home his heels were bleeding. The back of the shoe has a hard plastic seam right where it rubs. Not okay for kids.
the sweatpants are super comfy, i was lowkey in love. then i washed them and the drawstring disappeared into the waistband and i cant get it out. now they just fall down. ri

I'll be thorough since I spent some time with this.

Positives:
- Lightweight
- Bright colors, as shown
- Shipped fast

Negatives:
- Seams on both sleeves started to separate after one wash
- The zipper pull is plastic and snapped off within two weeks
- It is not water resistant at all despite the product title; water soaked through in a light drizzle

Final verdict: not recommended for anything other than a dry day
THE BAG ITSELF IS OK BUT IT DOES NOT LOOK LIKE THE PICTURE AND THE SELLER WILL NOT ADMIT IT. I SENT THEM PHOTOS AND THEY SAID "PRODUCT MAY VARY." THEN DON'T POST A PICTURE!

The robe is soft and my wife wore it once and liked it. Then it went through the wash and came out looking like a used towel, completely matted. I followed the instructions. For a gift this expensive, she should have been able to wear it more than once
The skirt is a lot shorter than the model shows.  On me it's not a mini skirt, it's a belt.

The fitness tracker counts steps when I'm sitting in the car. It counted 3,000 steps on my commute. It also doesn't count steps when I'm actually walking with my arms still. Completely useless data

I'll say these kids' raincoats are cute and the colors are bright, which makes them easy to see.  But the hoods don't stay on in the wind, and the seams leak at the shoulders.  Both my kids came home damp.  Not much better than a sweatshirt
I bought these "stretchy" plus size jeans.  They stretched exactly once.  Now they're stuck that way, sagging at the knees and the seat
The water bottle that came with this running vest leaks from the cap no matter how tight I screw it on. I ended up with wet shorts every run. Annoying and poorly made

I love the style of this hat and it's really chic.  But the brim is floppy in all the wrong ways and it blows right off in the slightest breeze.  I lost it twice on my first walk on the beach.  Cute in pictures, useless outside

The shirt is very small, like for children.  I order size XL and it fit my 12 year old daughter.  The size chart is completely wrong.  I cannot return because the shipping is very expensive to my country
THE SNEAKERS ARE OK BUT THEY TOOK A MONTH TO SHIP, AND THE BOX WAS ALL BEAT UP. ONE SHOE HAD A DENT IN THE TOE. I'M NOT GOING TO BOTHER RETURNING BUT I'M ALSO NOT GOING TO ORDER AGAIN!

The jacket claims to be "rated to minus 20." I wore it on a minus 5 morning walk and was shivering within fifteen minutes. The fill is noticeably sparse in the sleeves and back. That rating is optimistic at best

I'll say these work gloves have a decent grip. That's where the positives end. The seams at the fingertips split on the first day of moving lumber, and by the end of the week both palms had holes. Not work gloves, just glove

My girlfriend loves these slippers in the store, so I ordered her a pair online for her birthday. They look identical. They're not. The ones I received are much thinner, with a hard plastic sole instead of the soft one. She said she loves them, but she's back to wearing her old ones
these headphones sound like they're underwater. like everything is muffled. tried 3 different phones. its them not me
Way too big and cheaply made

I liked this diaper backpack because it frees up my hands, and the bottle pockets are insulated.  But the straps are so narrow that they dig into my shoulders after just a few minutes, and there's no chest strap.  It slides off constantly when I'm carrying my baby.  Not comfortable at all

I'll give the rain boots this much: they're very good at keeping the water in. Once it gets in through the crack in the heel, it stays there all day, sloshing gently. My feet have never been so moisturized
The wedding garter I ordered had a big piece of lace missing on one side.  I didn't notice until the morning of the wedding.  There was no time to replace it.  I wore it inside out
I note with interest that the product photo shows a full grain leather wallet with hand stitching. What I received had neither. Perhaps there are two products with the same name

I'll give this car mount credit for holding my phone steady on smooth roads. But on anything bumpy it rattles loose and the phone falls into my lap or under the seat. That's dangerous when I'm using it for directions. Back to holding it in my hand at red lights
The baby's first shoes I ordered have a sole so slippery that my daughter keeps falling on our wood floors. She was walking fine barefoot. These shoes made her worse. Disappointing

The windbreaker is light and packs small, I liked that for travel. But the hood has no drawstring so it flies off in any real wind, which is kind of the whole point of a windbreaker. I wore it once on a breezy day and the hood was useless
The 3X tank top I ordered is made of such thin fabric that it shows every roll and line. The armholes are also cut so low that my bra shows from the side. I can't wear it anywhere
The jeans are described as "boyfriend fit." I think they mean the boyfriend is twelv
I'VE NEVER HAD A COMPANY HANG UP ON ME BEFORE.  I CALLED TO ASK WHY MY ORDER WASN'T SHIPPED AFTER 3 WEEKS AND THEY HUNG UP.  TWICE.  GET YOUR ACT TOGETHER

In fairness, the jeans are a nice dark wash and the fabric feels substantial. However, the measurements are inconsistent: the waist is 1.5 inches larger than labeled, the inseam 2 inches shorter. Two pairs of the same size measured differently from each other. Quality control is lacking.
These scrubs started fading after only a few washes, and the color is now completely uneven.  I look like I'm wearing a tie-dye shirt in the hospital.  Not professional at all

The material of this sweater is very soft and warm, I like it.  But after I wash in cold water with hand, it become very big, the sleeve come to my fingers.  I don't understand how it is possible.  Now it look like a dress.
the description said 'premium quality.' the shirt came in a ziploc bag with the tag stapled on

ONE STAR ONLY BECAUSE ZERO IS NOT AN OPTION. ORDERED A MEN'S LARGE, GOT A CHILD'S LARGE. RETURN LABEL NEVER CAME. EMAILS BOUNCE BACK. PHONE NUMBER IS DISCONNECTED. DO YOUR HOMEWORK BEFORE YOU BUY FROM THESE PEOPLE

I read the earlier reviews before purchasing and dismissed the complaints about sizing as the usual grumbling. I owe those reviewers an apology. The shoes are handsome and well finished, but the 10.5 is closer to a 9.5, and the toe box is so narrow that my little toe was numb by the time I reached the end of my street. My podiatrist would not approve. Neither do I!
Does anyone else's pair have the heel that wobbles? Mine started wobbling the second time I wore them and now it clicks every step. Super annoying and kind of scary on stairs

Payless used to carry a shoe almost identical to this for half the price, so when they stopped I ordered these online for my daughter. The look is right and she likes the color. But the toe cap scuffed through to the white underneath in less than two weeks of school, and the velcro has already stopped holding. I'll be looking for the Payless ones on clearance

Based on the description ("heavyweight 12 oz canvas"), I expected a sturdy tote.  I weighed a single layer square against a known 12 oz canvas sample: this fabric is roughly 7 oz.  The handles are also stitched with a single line of thread and have begun to pull loose after carrying groceries twice.  This is not heavyweight.

The USB charging cable that came with this case is a nice bonus, and the case itself has a soft lining inside. But the case adds so much bulk that the player doesn't fit in my car's dock anymore, and the cutout for the hold switch is in the wrong place on my model even though it's listed as compatible. I spent an evening cutting it with an exacto knife and now it looks homemade.

Ladies, if you have any kind of curves, skip this skirt. The waistband is not stretchy at all and the hips are cut straight. I sized up twice and it still pulled across my hips while the waist gaped. I've given up on this brand

These black work pants look professional out of the package and the price was good for a uniform requirement. Unfortunately after five or six washes they've faded to a charcoal gray, and the hem on one leg has come down. My manager pointed out that my pants don't match the rest of the team. Had to buy new ones

Wore these running tights for a 10K and the drawstring snapped at mile 2. Spent the next four miles holding them up with one hand. The fabric is also so thin that I could see my knee through it when I stretched. Definitely not race-ready

I purchased this pendant for my wife for our 10th anniversary.  The design is lovely and she said she liked it.  But when she put it on, the bail (the loop that holds the chain) was so small that the pendant wouldn't slide along the chain, and the chain itself is so thin that it snapped the first week.  I've since replaced the chain with a better one at a local jeweler, which cost almost as much as the pendant

Our flower girl's dress arrived three sizes too large even though we ordered by the chart.  With only a week to go our seamstress had to take it in so much that the waist seams are bulky and uneven.  In the pictures you can see it.  Disappointing
idk who designed these sweatpants but the pockets are so shallow my phone falls out when i sit down. lost it in an uber. never again

The shoes look very nice and the price was good. But the size is not standard, I am always 42 and this 42 is very small, maybe 40. Also the inside material make my feet very hot and smell. I cannot wear them in the summer in Greece
Shout out to this hoodie for its incredible commitment to shrinking. It's gone from adult medium to "what my nephew wears to preschool" in three washes. Admirable consistency

The baby bath robe is cute with the little bear ears on the hood, and my husband loves putting her in it after bath time.  But the terry cloth is so thin it doesn't actually dry her, it just kind of moves the water around.  She ends up cold and fussy.  We use a regular towel now!
Junk.  Stitching came out in a day
THE PANTS ARE FINE QUALITY BUT THEY CHARGED ME $14.95 SHIPPING FOR ONE PAIR OF PANTS IN A PLASTIC BAG. THE SHIPPING LABEL ON THE BAG SAID $3.80. THAT'S A RIP OFF

My late wife bought me my first pair of these slippers in 1987.  I have bought them since.  This pair, the first since the company changed hands, has a sole that came away from the upper on the twelfth day.

I wanted a little black dress that I could wear to work and then out after, and this one looked perfect online. The cut is flattering, I'll say that. But the fabric wrinkles so badly that by lunchtime it looks like I slept in it, and the lining is so static-y it clings to my tights. I steamed it twice in one day. Not practical at all
My kids' new school shoes squeak so loudly that the teacher sent a note home.  Not the soles, the whole shoe squeaks when they bend their feet.  I've never heard of such a thing.  We switched brands

This watch has a "light" button that lights up for half a second, which is not long enough to read the time.  The alarm also can't be set to go off on weekdays only, it's every day or nothing.  The manual is a single page with four lines of instructions.  Very frustrating

Let me give credit where it's due.  The sunglasses are polarized as advertised, and the case is sturdy.  However, the frame is not "flexible titanium" as described; it's a painted plastic that has already begun to chip at the temples.  The nose pads also slide down on any warm day.  Overall, the frame is not worth what they charge

I really wanted these swim goggles to work because they have a great wide view.  But the seal around the eyes is hard plastic instead of silicone, and they leave deep red rings around my eyes for an hour after swimming.  They also leak if you turn your head to breathe.  Back to my old ones

The fabric on this blazer is really nice, and the color is a great neutral gray.  But the plus sizes are just the straight sizes made wider, so the shoulders are huge and the sleeves hang past my fingertips while the bust is still too tight to button.  I'd need a tailor to fix it, which isn't worth the cost

I ordered this sweater for my son's birthday and they sent a completely different style in a different color. When I asked for an exchange, they told me the sweater I ordered was discontinued and offered store credit. I don't want store credit. I want the sweater I paid for

I bought these nursing clogs because several coworkers recommended them. The pair I got has a defect in the left footbed, there's a hard bump under my arch, and the company won't exchange them because I wore them for one shift. I can't wear them again

honestly the jacket is warm and the hood is nice and big. BUT the sleeves are so long they cover my hands and the zipper keeps getting stuck halfway. walking to class trying to zip a jacket in a snowstorm is not fun.

I ordered these bridal earrings because they matched my necklace perfectly.  They're beautiful and sparkly.  But the posts are so thin that one bent while I was putting it in, and I couldn't straighten it without snapping it.  I got married with one earring in and one in my maid of honor's purse.

In fairness, these sandals are extremely lightweight. That's mostly because they appear to be made of the same material as a pool noodle. They were destroyed by a single afternoon at the park. My dog has chew toys that are more durable

I am very angry. I pay for express shipping to Australia and the package take 6 week. When arrive, the shirt have a big hole in the back. The seller say they are not responsible for damage. I will never order again.
Too small, too thin, too expensive

I bought these baby legwarmers because they're supposed to stay up during crawling. They slide down to his ankles in about five minutes and he gets tangled in them. He's now scared to crawl when he's wearing them. Totally useless

I was glad to find these gentleman's garters still available, as they are increasingly hard to find.  The elastic is sufficient and the clasp is firm, but the metal is so poorly finished that it snagged and laddered two pairs of good socks the first week.  I have filed the edges myself but should not have needed to
The top is completely see-through. Not a little sheer, completely see-through. Even with a nude bra it looks like I'm wearing nothing underneath. Who is this for
THEY SENT ME AN EMAIL ASKING ME TO REVIEW THE ITEM I NEVER RECEIVED.  HERE IS MY REVIEW: I NEVER RECEIVED IT

My daughter wanted this princess dress for her birthday party and it's so pretty that she twirled for an hour.  Then a little girl at the party stepped on the hem and the whole skirt tore away from the bodice.  My daughter was in tears.  It's held together by a few threads, nothing more.

I'll admit the sound quality on these earbuds is better than I expected for the price. But the cord is so short that I can't put my player in my pocket and wear them at the same time without the earbuds getting pulled out. Also the left bud started buzzing within two weeks. I've gone back to my old pair

The watch strap is listed as 20 mm. It measures 18 mm, which leaves a visible gap at the lugs on my watch and allows the pins to rattle. I checked with two separate calipers to be sure. It is the wrong size, plain and simple
Wore these "moisture-wicking" socks on a long run. They wicked the moisture straight into my shoes.
The swim skirt is cut so short that it doesn't cover anything it's supposed to. I'm 5'4" and I could see the bottoms under it. I don't know who they tested this on!

The dress shoes have a nice polished look for meetings and the leather is soft.  But the soles are so thin that after two months of walking from the train I have a hole worn right under the ball of my foot.  That's a new low for any shoe I've owned

I bought a set of these pajamas for my parents for Christmas.  They liked the plaid and the fabric is soft.  But my dad's pair shrank so much after the first wash that the pants are now capris on him, and my mom's top lost two buttons the first night.  Not a great gift
this backpack says it fits a 17 inch laptop. it fits a 17 inch laptop if you leave the zipper open and pray.
The wedding shoes I bought are labeled as comfortable all day. My feet were bleeding by the cocktail hour. Absolutely not comfortable all da

The color of this sweater is very nice and the style is modern.  But the material is not wool like description, it is acrylic, and after two days it have many small balls.  In my country I can buy same quality for very cheap.  I feel I pay too much
I bought these "high performance" gym shorts.  The only thing they performed was a dramatic split down the back seam during lunges, in front of everyone

The umbrella I ordered, with a handsome wooden handle, turned inside out the first time it met a breeze and two ribs snapped.  My grandfather carried one like it for decades.  I will not carry this one for another week.

I wanted to love this nursing pillow because the cover is so soft and the print is adorable.  But the pillow itself is so flat and squishy that it doesn't hold my baby at the right height, so I'm hunched over every feeding.  My back is killing me.  I went back to the one my sister lent me.
Arrived damaged and late.

These are the cutest little ankle boots, the color is perfect for fall.  But the zipper on the side started separating the second day and now it unzips while I'm walking.  I've tried pinching it with pliers and that didn't work either.  So disappointing
THE HAT IS FINE BUT THEY SENT IT IN AN ENVELOPE AND IT ARRIVED CRUSHED FLAT.  I SPENT AN HOUR WITH A STEAMER TRYING TO FIX THE SHAPE.  STILL NOT RIGHT.  PACK YOUR PRODUCTS PROPERL

The backpack's internal organization is genuinely well thought out, with a padded laptop sleeve, pen loops, and a key clip.  However:

- The bottom fabric has already begun to wear through at the corners
Not durable enough for daily commuting.

The portable speaker's battery dies after an hour, not the 8 hours advertised. It also takes about 6 hours to recharge. And the Bluetooth connection drops if I walk into the next room. Very disappointed
We bought this sun hat for our toddler for the beach. The chin strap is so short it chokes him, and without it the hat blows off. Neither option works. We left it in the car
I was so excited to find a cute wrap dress in my size. Then I discovered the "wrap" only goes about two-thirds of the way around

I'll say the climbing harness is comfortable around the waist, which is more than I can say for my old one.  But the leg loops aren't adjustable and they're cut for someone with very thin thighs.  I was cutting off circulation within ten minutes.  I can't trust something that I can't get to fit properly

I'm a teacher and I bought this cardigan for the classroom because it's supposed to be machine washable. It came out of the washer with holes in both elbows and the buttons pulled loose. Machine washable apparently means "machine destroyable".
My husband opened the necktie I bought him and said "it's very... shiny." Then he wore it once to make me happy. It's still in the closet
these flip flops broke at the toe thing on day 2 of spring break. had to walk around barefoot on hot sand. so mad

The bridal shoes are beautiful, I'll be honest, and the pearl details match my dress perfectly. But the heel is so slippery on the bottom that I nearly fell walking down the aisle, and during the reception I had to switch to flats because I was scared of slipping on the dance floor. Gorgeous, but dangerous.
I order the black color. They send me black color. But after the first wash, now it is gray color

I'll give this hat credit for being stylish. Unfortunately, the style it's going for is "giant flapping bird," because the brim catches every breeze and tries to take off. I've chased it across two parking lots. I'm getting my steps in, at least

The quality of the cotton in these shirts is fine and the color is as shown. But the pocket is sewn on crooked on two of the three, and on one the buttonholes are not cut through properly, so the buttons cannot be fastened. I would not expect such carelessness from a reputable maker.
Not as pictured.  Very disappointed
The car seat canopy blocks only a small part of the sun and blows up in the wind, so it flaps against my baby's face.  She cries every time we go outside with it.  It's coming of
The website says this jacket is "cropped." It barely covers my bra. Is it a jacket or a collar
THE SHOES WERE CLEARLY WORN BEFORE.  DIRT ON THE BOTTOM, CREASES ON THE TOE.  WHEN I COMPLAINED THEY OFFERED ME 15% OFF MY NEXT ORDER.  THERE WILL NOT BE A NEXT ORDER

The product description says "crystal clear sound." The sound is crystal clear if you like your music with a constant layer of static.

The bike lock's key broke off inside the lock on the third use. The lock had to be cut off. The bike is fine, but now I have no lock and I'm out the money.

These work shoes are comfortable for standing, which I liked.  But the rubber sole leaves black marks all over the white floor at the clinic and the cleaning staff complained.  I've had to switch to a different pair.  They should be labeled as non-marking or not.
I bought a bracelet for my niece's confirmation.  The clasp broke the first time she tried to close it.  She's 13, not exactly rough on things.  It was an embarrassing gift

the sneakers look sick and they're super light. but they have literally no support and my feet hurt after walking around campus for an hour. plus the white already turned gray after 2 weeks. they look old already.

I am from France.  The product never arrive.  The tracking say it is in the customs since 2 month.  The seller say it is not their problem.  Very bad service.
These sunglasses make everything look slightly blurry and green, which is fun if you want to experience the world as a frog.

I have bought this brand of cotton boxer for twenty years. This latest package contains boxers with an elastic waistband that has lost its grip after two weeks. I find myself hitching them up throughout the day, which is a new and unwelcome experience.
Wrong size.  Bad seller

I really liked the color of these skinny jeans and they looked so cute when I first put them on. But by the end of the day they had stretched out so much that the knees bagged and the waist slid down. I had to wear a belt and they still looked sloppy. Disappointing
The baby hat shrank after one wash and now it doesn't fit over her ears. I washed it in cold. It was a pricey hat for something that lasted a week

The scarf is a pleasant weight and the plaid is well woven.  However, the label claims 100% cashmere, and the fabric has the springiness and slight sheen of a wool-acrylic blend.  After two weeks of wear it has pilled along the edges.  If it is cashmere, it is of very poor grade
The tag says these jeans have reinforced knees. My son has reinforced the holes in them quite well

The case is slim and doesn't add much bulk, which is what I wanted. But it doesn't protect anything. I dropped my phone from about waist height and the screen cracked right through the case. I should have just bought a real case

The plus size robe I ordered barely closes across my front. The belt is too short to tie. I ordered the largest size they make and it fits like a medium. Disappointing for a brand that advertises extended sizes
Ran my first half marathon in these shorts. Finished the race. The shorts did not.

I've been a size 18 for most of my adult life and I'm used to the struggle, but this nightgown really surprised me. It's a beautiful soft knit, a pretty lilac color, and the lace at the neckline is lovely. Then I put it on. The armholes are so tight that I can feel the seam cutting into my arms, and the length is listed as 46 inches but it's barely 38 on me. I can't sleep comfortably in something that pinches and rides up. Such a shame because the fabric is lovely.

I've owned three of these alarm clock radios over the years and the first two were great.  This one has the same look, but they've changed the internals.  The radio reception is much weaker, I can only get two stations clearly in my bedroom where the old one got twelve.  The buttons also feel cheaper and the snooze button sticks.  When the clock lost power in a storm it reset to midnight and didn't keep my alarm settings, which the old one always did.  Feels like they cut corners everywhere

I must say at the outset that I bought this raincoat on the strength of the brand's reputation, which I have trusted since my army days.  The cut is excellent and the coat looks smart.  Unfortunately, it is not waterproof.  In a steady drizzle on my walk to church, water came through at the shoulders and soaked my suit jacket.  I have sprayed it with a proofing solution twice with little improvement.  A raincoat that does not keep out rain is merely a coat

I bought this headband to wear at my wedding because it was a fraction of the cost of the ones at the bridal salon. In the pictures online it looked identical. It arrived quickly and looked pretty in the box. But the band is a hard plastic that dug in behind my ears, and after an hour I had a pounding headache. By the time we cut the cake I'd taken it off. My hairstylist said the band should have been padded or wrapped. Cheaper isn't always better

My mother-in-law collects scarves, so I thought this silk one would be a safe birthday gift. The pattern is beautiful and it came in a nice box. Unfortunately it's not silk, it's polyester, and she could tell immediately. She was very gracious but I could see her face. The listing very clearly says 100% silk. I've since read other reviews saying the same thing. I wish I'd read them first

Ok so I bought this jacket because every influencer seemed to have one and it looked so good in their photos. And it does look good, for about a day. The faux leather started cracking at the elbows after maybe five wears and the lining ripped when I put my arm in a little too fast. For the price I expected at least a season out of it.
bought these joggers for the gym and the waistband elastic is already shot after a month. they slide down every time i squat. had to tie the drawstring so tight it hurts. not worth it

To be fair, the gloves are warm in still air and the touch screen fingertips do work on my phone. But after testing them for a week:

For winter commuting they are not adequat

I am living in Chile and I order 2 pair of jeans. When arrive, one pair is the right size and one pair is very different size even the tag is the same. I think they put wrong tag. I cannot return because is too expensive. Very bad experience.

Fell apart.  Total wast

The rechargeable batteries that came with this camera die after about 20 pictures.  I charged them overnight several times.  I bought a different brand of batteries and they last for hundreds of pictures.  The included batteries are basically useless.

The skirt has a lining that's shorter than the skirt itself, and the fabric of the skirt is so thin that you can see the line of the lining through it.  It looks like I'm wearing two skirts.  Not cute

I'll say the tennis skirt is cute and the built-in shorts are comfortable. But the shorts are so short that they ride up when I run for a ball, and the pocket for the tennis ball is too small to actually hold a tennis ball. I don't understand how no one noticed that before selling it
the description says these jeans are 'distressed.' after 2 weeks i'm distressed too, because the crotch is gon

THE QUALITY OF THE DRESS IS OK BUT IT CAME WITH THE PRICE TAG FROM ANOTHER STORE STILL ON IT, FOR HALF WHAT I PAID. SO THEY'RE BUYING IT ELSEWHERE AND RESELLING IT. I FEEL RIPPED OFF

Credit to these pajama pants: they're soft and warm.  Unfortunately the drawstring is decorative only, meaning I've lost them in the hallway twice on the way to the coffee maker.  The dog was confused.  I was col
